question: In Arc 1, when Ton, Chin, and Kan are messing up Subaru, Emilia somehow or other shows up to help, and Felt runs by without a second glance. What might the other royal candidates have done in that situation?
answer: Anastasia would say “Eww, I saw something unpleasant.” and take another way, Crusch would say “I can’t overlook this outrage.” and wade in, Priscilla might or might not intervene, depending on her mood.
